name: AMD iGPU · Use swangle rendering (Example)
author: ApkStart
description: On some AMD iGPUs with older drivers, -gpu host passes the emulator self-check but the guest crashes ~10s after boot (log only shows AEHD is operational). Pinning the renderer to swangle works around this at the cost of slightly lower frame rate.

notes: If visuals are normal but games lag, set "Display Quality" to 540x960 in Settings
Once verified, set enabled to true or remove that line to activate automatically
